My round-11 probe is kept and extended as probes/dom-r12-editor-tokens.spec.ts.txt, and its part C now asserts what the author is told. Run: 2 passed, rc 0 (probe-editor-tokens.log). The form now shows one role=alert inside the form, with data-problem=automation_rule.restricted_token_stale and the catalogue text. EN: 'A condition value is a restricted-record token that was not issued for this version as it now stands (it comes from an earlier save, another version or another rule), so nothing was saved. The rule editor shows the version as it is stored now: re-apply your change using only the values shown for this version, and do not reuse a token copied from elsewhere.' AR: the same meaning ('… لذلك لم يُحفظ أي شيء. يعرض محرر القواعد الإصدار بحالته المحفوظة الآن …'). '[data-state=rule-changed-reapply]' is absent, and the text 'This rule changed after you opened it' / 'تغيّرت هذه القاعدة بعد أن فتحتها' appears nowhere on the page. The form reloads the stored version, so the pasted token is gone (C7). New cases, each 422 stale with the same alert and nothing stored: (D) a token copied from another rule's editor; (E) the retired pre-0127 form [restricted:<row version>:2]. (F) Doing what the text says, re-applying with this version's own values only, saves (200, v2 = [P, H, Q]) and clears the alert. Part B still shows the 409 'changed, re-apply' alert (hard assertion). Every sentence of the new text is true in this flow: nothing was saved, the editor shows the stored version, and the token came from another version, rule or earlier save. (2) Mutants.
